description: Build 7 stem-targeted Suno Studio audio-effect plugins for the INSTRUMENTAL / non-lead-vocal stems, each in its own subfolder plugins/<name>/<name>.plugin.json, structurally parallel to the six existing vocal plugins and using ONLY confirmed g.* primitives. These are kind:'effect' processors (audioIn -> audioOut) dropped onto a specific Suno Studio stem. Independent of each other (all follow the same template), but delivered as one coherent unit.
steps: Before writing, re-read plugins/AUTHORING.md and at least plugins/intimate-proximity/..., plugins/vintage-lofi-voicer/..., plugins/de-esser/... (envelope + asymmetricOnePole coef pattern), and plugins/digital-degrade/... (the 8-level amplitude quantizer staircase). Match their JSON structure, param schema, source.metadata (controls + ui.compact), header-comment style, bypass-via-g.lerp, dry/wet-via-g.lerp, assumed gainDb on shelf/peaking biquads, and terminal g.tanh EXACTLY.

Create plugins/sub-tightener/sub-tightener.plugin.json (BASS stem). Chain: input trim -> highpass at 'hp freq' to remove sub-rumble -> isolate a low band (g.biquad lowpass) and tame its boom with an envelope follower (g.asymmetricOnePole on g.abs of the low band, coef = clamp(1 - 1/(seconds*sr),0,0.9999) as in de-esser) attenuating by 'tighten' amount -> low-shelf 'warmth' add for controlled weight -> tanh 'drive' -> dry/wet 'mix' -> output gain -> bypass g.lerp -> terminal g.tanh. Params: input gain, hp freq (hz, log), tighten (percent), warmth (db), drive (db), dry/wet mix (percent), output gain, bypass.

Create plugins/warm-keys-voicer/warm-keys-voicer.plugin.json (KEYS stem). Chain: input trim -> attack-soften via envelope (follow g.abs, blend original toward the smoothed envelope-shaped signal by 'attack soften' to round transients) -> warm tilt EQ (lowshelf +tilt near 250Hz, highshelf -tilt near 5kHz using g.mul by -1, single 'warmth/tilt' param) -> light tanh 'saturation' -> highshelf 'air' add -> dry/wet 'mix' -> output gain -> bypass -> terminal g.tanh. Params: input gain, warmth/tilt (db), attack soften (percent), saturation (db), air (db), dry/wet mix (percent), output gain, bypass.

Create plugins/guitar-grit-warmth/guitar-grit-warmth.plugin.json (GUITAR stem). Chain: input trim -> warmth tilt EQ (shelving biquads, single 'warmth tilt' param) -> tanh 'grit/drive' saturation -> peaking 'presence' bump near 3kHz -> lowpass 'tone' -> dry/wet 'mix' -> output gain -> bypass -> terminal g.tanh. Serves clean fingerpicked acoustic (low grit) through distorted/overdriven guitar (high grit). Params: input gain, warmth tilt (db), grit (db), presence (db), tone (hz, log lowpass), dry/wet mix (percent), output gain, bypass.

Create plugins/string-air-size/string-air-size.plugin.json (STRINGS stem). Chain: input trim -> highshelf 'air' lift near 10kHz -> low-mid control via a peaking or lowshelf 'body' near 300Hz -> 'size/tilt' shelving pair for distant(<->)chamber balance -> gentle tanh 'saturation' for body -> dry/wet 'mix' -> output gain -> bypass -> terminal g.tanh. Params: input gain, air (db), body (db), size/tilt (db), saturation (db), dry/wet mix (percent), output gain, bypass.

Create plugins/synth-cold-glitch/synth-cold-glitch.plugin.json (SYNTH stem). Chain: input trim -> cold tilt EQ (lowshelf cut + highshelf lift, single 'cold tilt' param, negative-lows/positive-highs) -> band voicing via highpass then lowpass at a 'filter' corner (cold bandpass feel) -> REUSE the digital-degrade 8-level amplitude quantizer staircase (sum of 7 g.compareLt comparators over [-1,1]) blended by 'quantize' amount (document it as the SAME fixed-depth approximation, cite AUTHORING.md) -> tanh 'drive' -> dry/wet 'mix' -> output gain -> bypass -> terminal g.tanh. Params: input gain, cold tilt (db), quantize (percent), filter (hz, log), drive (db), dry/wet mix (percent), output gain, bypass. In the header comment, note the quantizer is copied from digital-degrade and is a FIXED-DEPTH amplitude quantizer (not a variable bit crusher) because no runtime rounding primitive is confirmed.

Create plugins/backing-vocal-tucker/backing-vocal-tucker.plugin.json (BACKING VOCALS stem). Chain: input trim -> band-limit (highpass at 'hp' then lowpass at 'lp') to pull backing vox out of the lead's core band -> presence cut (peaking cut near 3kHz driven by 'presence cut' negative gainDb) -> tilt EQ ('tilt' param) -> apply a gentle static gain reduction scaled by 'tuck' amount so they sit behind the lead (g.mul by a linear factor derived from tuck; NOT sidechained, no lead available) -> dry/wet 'mix' -> output gain -> bypass -> terminal g.tanh. Params: input gain, tuck (db of attenuation), hp (hz, log), lp (hz, log), presence cut (db), tilt (db), dry/wet mix (percent), output gain, bypass. Note in header that the tuck is a static attenuation, not a lead-driven sidechain duck (no sidechain input available).

Create plugins/texture-filter-degrade/texture-filter-degrade.plugin.json (FX / OTHER stem). Chain: input trim -> highpass at 'hp' -> lowpass at 'lp' -> lo-fi tilt EQ ('lofi tilt' param, shelving pair) -> optional degrade: REUSE the digital-degrade 8-level amplitude quantizer staircase blended by 'degrade' amount (same documented fixed-depth approximation) -> dry/wet 'mix' -> output gain -> bypass -> terminal g.tanh. Params: input gain, hp (hz, log), lp (hz, log), lofi tilt (db), degrade (percent), dry/wet mix (percent), output gain, bypass.

For every plugin: include bypass toggle (enumOptions off/on, default off) implemented via g.lerp(bypass, out, trimmed); input gain and output gain knobs (unit db, range -24..24, default 0) converted via g.dbToLin; a dry/wet mix knob (unit percent, 0..100) via g.lerp(mix, trimmed, processed) with mix = clamp(pct/100,0,1); a per-channel chain(x) closure applied to both audioInL and audioInR; and a terminal g.tanh before g.output. Mirror ui.compact inside source.metadata.ui.compact and at the top-level ui.compact (12 cols, 4 rows, 3-wide/2-high knob boxes). Every description string must carry the Suno Studio / rendered-audio / not-a-lyric-tag framing and name the TARGET STEM (apply to the <stem> stem).

Validate: run python3 -c "import json,glob; files=sorted(glob.glob('plugins/**/*.plugin.json', recursive=True)); [json.load(open(f)) for f in files]; print(len(files),'files OK')" from repo root and confirm all 13 files parse. Then audit every g.* token in the 7 new source.code strings against the confirmed list and confirm no delay/reverb/noise/osc/oscillator/lfo/fft appears (grep the new files). Also grep the 7 new files for em dashes and confirm none.
Do NOT commit in this feature; the orchestrator commits after docs are done. Leave files staged-or-unstaged as created.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('plugins/**/*.plugin.json', recursive=True)]" exits 0 (all 13 plugin JSON files parse).

Every g.* call in the 7 new plugins is in the confirmed set (g.input,g.output,g.zero,g.constant,g.mul,g.add,g.sub,g.div,g.abs,g.max,g.min,g.clamp,g.lerp,g.compareLt,g.dbToLin,g.tanh,g.biquad,g.asymmetricOnePole) plus config.sampleRate; a grep for delay|reverb|noise|oscillator|\blfo\b|fft (case-insensitive) in the 7 new files returns no DSP-primitive usage.

Each of the 7 plugins has: bypass toggle (default off), input gain + output gain (db), a dry/wet mix (percent), a // signal-chain header comment, and a terminal g.tanh safety stage. The synth and texture plugins reuse the digital-degrade 8-level quantizer staircase and say so in the header.
No em dashes appear in any of the 7 new files.
Each plugin's description names its target Suno Studio stem and keeps the not-a-lyric-tag framing.
verification: From /projects/sandbox/songwriting-kb run: python3 -c "import json,glob; files=sorted(glob.glob('plugins/**/*.plugin.json', recursive=True)); [json.load(open(f)) for f in files]; print(len(files),'files OK')" and confirm it prints 13 files OK.
grep -rniE 'delay|reverb|noise|oscillator|\blfo\b|fft' the 7 new plugin files and confirm no unconfirmed g.* primitive is used (matches only inside prose/comments, if any, are not primitive calls).
grep for the unicode em dash in the 7 new files and confirm zero matches.
Spot-read 2 of the new files (synth-cold-glitch and sub-tightener) to confirm structural parallelism with the existing plugins and correct quantizer/envelope reuse.
findings: Created all 7 instrumental stem plugins, each in its own subfolder: plugins/sub-tightener (BASS: highpass sub-rumble removal + lowpass low-band isolate tamed by an asymmetricOnePole envelope follower using the de-esser coef = clamp(1 - 1/(seconds*sr),0,0.9999) pattern, lowshelf warmth, tanh drive), plugins/warm-keys-voicer (KEYS: envelope-based attack soften blended by percent, warm lowshelf/highshelf tilt via g.mul by -1, tanh saturation, highshelf air), plugins/guitar-grit-warmth (GUITAR: warmth tilt, tanh grit, peaking presence, lowpass tone; spans clean-to-overdriven), plugins/string-air-size (STRINGS: highshelf air, lowshelf body, size/tilt shelving pair, gentle tanh saturation), plugins/synth-cold-glitch (SYNTH: cold tilt, filter-derived highpass+lowpass bandpass feel, REUSED digital-degrade 8-level quantizer staircase blended by quantize, tanh drive), plugins/backing-vocal-tucker (BACKING VOCALS: hp/lp band-limit, peaking presence cut, tilt, STATIC gain reduction via g.dbToLin(-tuck), header notes it is not a lead-driven sidechain since no sidechain input exists), plugins/texture-filter-degrade (FX/OTHER: hp/lp band-limit, lo-fi tilt, REUSED digital-degrade 8-level quantizer blended by degrade). Every plugin: valid JSON, structurally parallel to the six existing (id/kind/displayName/description/ports/parameters/source{lang,metadata{controls,ui.compact}}/ui.compact), bypass toggle default off via g.lerp(bypass,out,trimmed), input+output gain (db) via g.dbToLin, dry/wet mix (percent) via g.lerp(mix,trimmed,processed), // signal-chain header comment, per-channel chain(x) on audioInL/audioInR, terminal g.tanh. Synth and texture reuse the digital-degrade quantizer verbatim and cite AUTHORING.md as a FIXED-DEPTH quantizer (no runtime rounding primitive). backing-vocal-tucker has 9 params so its 12x4 ui.compact grid uses w=2 boxes (5 top row, 4 bottom row) rather than the usual w=3 8-box layout; mirrored in source.metadata.ui.compact. VERIFICATION: python3 JSON parse prints '13 files OK'; g.* token audit against the confirmed set returns NONE unexpected (config.sampleRate is the only sampleRate use, matching de-esser; grep for 'g.sampleRate' is a false-positive substring of 'config.sampleRate'); grep for delay|reverb|noise|oscillator|lfo|fft returns no matches; grep for the unicode em dash returns no matches; params==controls==top ui.compact==metadata ui.compact for all 7. NOT committed (orchestrator commits after docs). Plugins ship UNVERIFIED: no Node runtime or Suno Studio in the sandbox, so DSP was not executed.
